title: Comfort Club Cancellation and Refund Terms
content:
Membership terms on cancelling a Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements agreement. Clauses marked as no longer in force are superseded by the current basis and are not applied.

1. **The member's decision.** Cancelling an agreement is the member's own decision: the agent records a cancellation request that the member confirms themselves.
2. **Effective date.** The cancellation takes effect only once the member has confirmed a cancellation request on the agreement, and it takes effect on the date of confirmation, which becomes the cancelled date. The request and its status on record are the evidence.
3. **Annual agreements.** For an annually billed agreement a cancellation proration credit is computed for the current term.
4. **Full-refund window.** The full-refund treatment applies only when the member gives notice of this cancellation no later than the tier's full-refund window in calendar days after the current term began. Refund-window days are counted with the term start date as day 0, and notice received on the last day of the window qualifies.
5. *(No longer in force.)* The former clause setting the credit under the full-refund treatment at the dues billed for the current term less the retail value of the visits completed in the term and less the covered-repair benefit drawn in the term, with no cancellation fee charged, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.
6. *(No longer in force.)* The former clause setting the credit outside the window at the dues billed for the term multiplied by the unused full months divided by twelve, rounded to the cent half up, less the same retail value of completed visits and covered-repair benefit drawn, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.
7. **Cancellation fee outside the window (in force).** Outside the full-refund window a cancellation fee at the tier's cancellation fee is charged where that fee is above 0.00.
8. **Floor.** A credit is never negative; when the deduction exceeds the dues, the credit is zero and the member owes nothing further for the visits.
9. **Posting condition.** A cancellation proration credit is posted only to an agreement whose status is cancelled.
10. **Monthly agreements.** A monthly agreement earns no proration credit: dues already billed are not refunded, the cancellation fee rule above still applies outside the window, and any unpaid dues remain owed.
11. **Closure of benefits.** At cancellation the remaining visits and covered-repair benefit expire as closed with the agreement.
12. **Payout.** When the agreement's dues balance is negative after the credit and any fee, that credit balance is paid out as a refund to the original payment method, naming the credit as its source.

### The refund window (hypothetical dates, 30-day window)

| Term start (day 0) | Notice received | Day number | Full-refund treatment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 April 2025 | 10 May 2025 | day 30 | Applies (last day of the window) |
| 10 April 2025 | 11 May 2025 | day 31 | Does not apply |

### Points of judgement
- A monthly member cancelling on day 45 of a term on a tier with a 25.00 cancellation fee: no proration credit, the 25.00 fee is charged, and any unpaid monthly dues remain owed.
- A dues balance of minus 40.00 after the credit and fee is paid out as a 40.00 refund to the original payment method.

superseded_clauses: Under the full-refund treatment the credit is the dues billed for the current term less the retail value of the visits completed in the term (tuneup_retail_value_usd per completed tune-up and whole_home_visit_retail_value_usd per completed whole-home visit) less the covered-repair benefit drawn in the term, and no cancellation fee is charged.
